conditions.ambient: actual createSoundscape.renderOffline graph, same recorded sources/loop offsets/listener; no copied mixer equations
conditions.sourcePreparation: recording prepared before enqueue and before startRendering
conditions.overlap: two identical recorded samples, same time/direction: deliberately coherent worst-case overlap

limits: OfflineAudioContext fixture, not a live browser capture or user listening acceptance
relative ambient is the actual production graph at declared fixed scene settings, not the earlier24s waveform replay
sample-peak and consecutive-full-scale checks are pre-WAV-encoding Float32; not an intersample true-peak meter
nearly constant peak run>=8samples is a hard-flat-top warning, not a subjective distortion meter
difference from ambient includes nonlinear master compressor response; not an isolated-source SPL estimate
DynamicsCompressorNode automatic makeup/lookahead are actual browser behavior; no guessed compressor gain formula
no synthesized low-frequency layer or change to distance/delay; physical SPL and playback-device response remain uncalibrated
comparisonBaseline: A07: gain3.6/postgain.8/attack2ms; user second listening rejected impact
scope: actual browser OfflineAudioContext, production clip/graphs, selected stronger runtime vs preserved A07; includes maximum current authored event energy1.15 coherent double
